Modified: STEP tessellation using OpenCascade via occt-import-js 0.0.23, VRML triangulation, millimetre conversion, compressed indexed geometry. STEP chordal tolerance 0.025 mm.
Models retain original placement and scaling. Some manufacturer project assignments use generic substituted packages, notably scaled BGAs; this is not a physically certified exact replica. Source URLs and SHA256 hashes are recorded per file in manifest.json.
